| [AM.MAN.DEX.BENCH.4] <a id="am-man-dex-bench-4"></a> | **DexBioLab｜Laboratory manipulation benchmark · Dynamic experiment visuals · Parallel realistic simulation**<br>[DexBioLab: Benchmarking Dexterous Manipulation with Dynamic Experimental Phenomena in Realistic Laboratories](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.13643v3)<br>Xuanye Wu, Yue Shi, Yongcan Yang, Yiqun Wang, Zhaoqi Wan, Dayu Xia, Yanming Shao, Jiezhang Cao, Xiangfei Li, Yao Mu, Guangtao Zhai<br>**Tags:** `benchmark` `dexterous` `gripper` `multi-embodiment` `bimanual` `biological-laboratory` `functional-tool-use` `precision-manipulation` `language-grounding` `instrument-operation` `dynamic-visual-effects` `gaussian-splatting` `hybrid-rendering` `mjlab` `parallel-simulation` `scripted-demonstrations` `closed-loop-evaluation` `sim-to-real` | **Hands:** Three dexterous hands: Shadow, Wuji and XHand, plus an Aloha gripper platform; four embodiments do not mean four dexterous hands. Includes single/bimanual setups; hardware validation uses UR5e + XHand.<br>**Tasks:** 14 entries, including Shadow/XHand tube-transfer variants, spanning tool use, precision, language grounding and instrument operation, e.g. pipetting, tweezers, caps, tips, burners and thermal cyclers. Main policy evaluation covers 12 tasks with 3 seeds × 100 rollouts each.<br>**Same-task cross-hand reuse:** Tasks use assigned embodiments; tube transfer explicitly has Shadow and XHand variants. Direct reuse of all tasks with arbitrary hands and shared-weight cross-hand transfer are not established.<br>**Release:** Simulation code is public with scene-download, PFSM collection, LeRobot rendering and OpenPI evaluation instructions; scene downloads were not tested. The project marks the dataset Coming soon. No official task-policy checkpoint download was found; examples require user-supplied trained weights.<br>**Key distinction:** Combines six real-lab 3DGS backgrounds, interactive foregrounds and controllable flame/vapor/bubble visuals for fine manipulation; mjlab parallel collection and decoupled replay rendering support closed-loop evaluation. Particles are visual effects decoupled from physics, not high-fidelity fluid, combustion or chemistry simulation.<br>**Evaluation scope:** Records requested v3; v4 exists. Simulation compares task-fine-tuned DP, π₀.₅, GR00T-N1.7 and Fast-WAM. Real tube-transfer validation uses 20 trials per condition: 3DGS/standard-background normalized progress is 66%/17%, not success rate. The v3 main text states 10 real + 90 simulated demonstrations, but the appendix states 100 real demonstrations; this discrepancy needs clarification. This is not established simulation-only zero-shot transfer. Public resources were inspected, not run locally. | arXiv v3 / 2026 | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.13643v3) · [Project](https://cumulusalpha.github.io/DexBioLabWebPage/) · [Code](https://github.com/CumulusAlpha/DexBioLab) | Initial reading<br>2026-10-25 |
